title: AZURE-001 Governed Acceptance Packet
summary: Consolidates release-bundle verification, readiness evidence, and reproducibility evidence into a review-only acceptance packet without granting Azure, publication, database, or production-migration authority.
decisions: Any release-bundle verification failure produces BLOCK
Azure provisioning, taxonomy publication, database mutation, and production migration remain permanently false in the packet
unresolved_gates: GitHub Actions run must register and pass
Exact WorldOrchids 26-08 source must pass governed real-data validation
Azure nonprofit credit linkage must be verified
Subscription budget alerts must be configured
Microsoft or assigned partner architecture review must be completed
